description: This is a shell script containing tests for a wildmatch pattern matching library. It defines test functions, runs various pattern matching tests, including edge cases and performance checks, to verify the correctness of wildmatch implementations.

methods.name: should_create_test_file
methods.description: Determines if a test file should be created for a given filename based on various rules to avoid filesystem limitations.

methods.name: match_with_function
methods.description: Runs a pattern match test using a specified match function (like wildmatch), and checks if the match status aligns with expectation.

methods.name: match_with_ls_files
methods.description: Runs pattern matching tests via git's ls-files command to verify file matching behavior in a git repository context.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Coordinates multiple pattern matching tests, covering glob, case-insensitive, path-specific, and extended patterns with detailed setup and verification.
